courses.title: Evidence

casebook.title: Course packets posted to D2L (rules, cases, problems)

courses.exam: Closed book, closed notes, rules and statutes supplied. Graded quizzes Oct 2, Oct 23, Nov 13; final tentatively Dec 12.
courses.notes: Evidence is the most rule-bound course. The Federal Rules ARE the outline: structure it by FRE numbering (100s, 401-415, 501-502, 601-615, 701-706, 801-807, 901-903, 1001-1008), not by casebook chapter. Build Article VIII (hearsay) deepest and confidence-score every exception individually. Closed book means the outline is a memorization aid, not a lookup instrument.

courses.title: Business Associations

casebook.title: Sjostrom, BUSINESS ORGANIZATIONS: A TRANSACTIONAL APPROACH (4th ed. 2023)

courses.assignment_source: 'BA Assignment Listing Fall 2026 (Exhibit C)' on D2L: ASSN 1-26, no dates, mapped onto the Wed/Fri meeting calendar
courses.exam: Wed Dec 16, Examplify, 3.5 hours, 70%. Open hard-copy textbook plus a printed personal outline of 25 pages or fewer. No AI, no internet.
courses.notes: She tests application, not recitation: two supplemental hypo sets posted before day one, iClicker every class, one running fact pattern on the exam. Build the outline as a hypo-solving instrument: rule, elements, application trigger. Case names go on the authority line, never as headers. Mark every rule default [D] or mandatory [M]. The exam is governed by 'Delamore', identical to the model acts, Delaware statutes, and assigned cases, so record MBCA/DGCL, RUPA/Delaware, RULLCA/WILLCA splits wherever they diverge. Hard 25-page outline ceiling: build to it from day one.

courses.title: Trusts and Estates

casebook.title: Sitkoff & Dukeminier, WILLS, TRUSTS, AND ESTATES (12th ed. 2025)

courses.exam: In-class final, 80%, OPEN OUTLINE + OPEN CASEBOOK. Date per the Law School exam schedule.
courses.notes: AI policy directly governs these notes: AI-phrased rule statements are permitted but every one must carry an AI cite that is reproduced on the exam next to the case cite; keep an AI citation ledger as an appendix of the master outline. AI may NOT be used to parse the Wisconsin statutes: leave statute sections blank for the student to read. She frames gratuitous transfer through familial, societal, and cultural heritage; capture that dimension, it surfaces in her essay prompts. Graded engagement with assigned case studies (films, articles) is 10% of the grade.

courses.exam: TBD. D2L has a Past Exams module: pull it first and build the outline backward from it.
courses.notes: Boyden organizes D2L by Unit, roughly one per class period, and adds Units as the semester runs. Track units in the synthesis and mirror the unit sequence in the outline. The course opens with constitutional privacy and shifts to statutory element-checking partway through; structure accordingly.
